This page collects the lecture slides for **SOC 111: Social Networks**. The decks are hosted as part of the companion textbook site, [*Social Networks: An Introduction*](https://olizardo.github.io/networks-textbook/). Use the arrow keys or the on-screen navigation to move through each deck. For the course syllabus, see [SOCIOL 111 (Social Networks Undergraduate Class)](../syllabi/SOCIOL111.html).
